Latin word

īnstruō

īnstruō, īnstruere, īnstrūxī, īnstrūctum

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

install (a program); fit out, equip (a room, a house); lay on, set up (a meal, a feast); equip, provide with everything needed; instruct, equip with knowledge

In this lexicon

  • install

    the recommended word · modern · Traupman 261, 333

  • install

    also used · classical · Traupman 333

  • organise

    also used · classical · Liv. 3.29.5: epulae īnstrūctae dīcuntur fuisse ante omnium domūs

  • provide

    also used · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.4.62: īnstruere et parāre convīvium omnibus rēbus (Lewis & Short)

  • teach

    also used · classical · Quint. 4.2.24: jūdicem nōtitiā rērum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 30; Traupman 333

Examples

  • Programma novum īnstrūxī; jam computātrum dēnuō excitandum est.

    I’ve installed the new program; now the computer has to be restarted.composed
